scope: workbench host for the bounded parameter editor (opt-in Checked editor in the Parameters tab), source verification, leaf draft rules; web UI only
base: origin/main 5a33e95c (lock commit; main unchanged at freeze)
findings: Save bumps the snapshot revision; the leaf blocked any draft on every revision change (same rule fixed for notes/instructions in package 2).
After a successful Apply the authoritative refresh changed value and revision, leaving the editor in a reload-me state although it showed exactly the applied value.
Real-server smoke: after a settled Apply, Undo made a clean editor keep the applied value as a stale conflict.
useDeviceParameters blanked the whole panel on every tree change, which would unmount an open editor (and its draft) on Save/Apply/Undo.

test_first.ParameterSourceEditor: RED 0/10 against a null stub then 10/10

gate.browser_parameters: 11/11 (EN/DE, Porcelain/Graphite, 1440/400: time count apply + settle, slider draft-only; DE400 colour fallback; EN1440 server refusal; no identity)

browser_fixtures.failures: device-editor-layout.e2e.ts x4 expecting raw DPST-9-1; same as untouched base d7df85c6

real_server_smoke.isolation: user+network namespace with only lo; HOME/XDG_*/KNX_DATA_DIR in task scratch
real_server_smoke.input: synthetic fictional schema-23 .knxproj embedding a schema-20 product (TypeTime Unit=Seconds, TypeNumber UIHint=Slider), imported through the UI
checks: server declares source evidence for the time parameter
checked editor offered for both rows
time count shows the exact stored lexeme and the declared unit
apply writes through the existing parameter route
undo restores the original value in server and editor
a parameter draft typed before Save survives it
closing returns the plain field with the stored value
reopened file keeps the applied value
real_server_smoke.note: two app release-check requests to api.github.com were observed and failed inside the namespace; they belong to the app's release check, not the editor

visual_review: EN/DE Porcelain/Graphite 1440/400 frames and real-server frames inspected directly; host buttons made quiet and the access badge compact after review
limitations: see KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 'Checked parameter editors in the device editor (2026-10-12)'
